invariants_checked: All 13 GitHub Actions workflows declare least-privilege top-level permissions (`contents: read` with job-scoped elevation only where required), pin third-party actions to 40-char commit SHAs, and avoid `pull_request_target` privilege escalation.

Zero untrusted GitHub event expressions (`issue.title`, `pull_request.body`, `head_ref`, commit messages) are interpolated directly inside `run:` shell blocks; dynamic inputs pass via `env:` variables.
All 6 issue/PR templates, dependabot configuration, and CI jobs use lowercase `genyee-*` image/artifact naming with zero legacy brand residues.
Preserved `dataset/README` and `dataset/README_zh.md` untouched per dataset attribution invariant; audited all 4 owned files (`qa_dataset.py` and `dataset/tests/*`).

`dataset/qa_dataset.py` reads Parquet inputs safely via `pyarrow`/`pandas` (zero `pickle` or unsafe `yaml.load`), validates non-empty `--model` before client initialization, and preserves resumable JSONL output integrity.
All 24 pytest cases and 3 subtests in `dataset/tests/` pass with 100% Parquet sample schema parity.
verification_commands: PYTHONDONTWRITEBYTECODE=1 uv run --with pandas --with pyarrow --with openai --with pytest python3 -m pytest dataset/tests/ -q (exit 0)

invariants_checked: All shipped Dockerfiles (`Dockerfile.app`, `Dockerfile.docreader`, `Dockerfile.odl-hybrid`, `Dockerfile.sandbox`) copy `LICENSE`, `THIRD_PARTY_NOTICES.md`, and `licenses/` (`check-license-bundle.sh` verified), use lowercase `genyee-*` OCI image titles, and run runtime workloads as non-root users where applicable.

`docker-compose.yml` and `docker-compose.dev.yml` bind infrastructure ports to `127.0.0.1` by default, enforce non-empty `minio` root credentials at startup, mint and persist a unique 256-bit random SearXNG `secret_key` when `SEARXNG_SECRET` is unset, avoid host-interpolated shell/SQL injection in `langfuse-db-init` and `postgres` healthchecks, and pass explicit `app`/`odl-hybrid` runtime env allowlists.

`docker/Dockerfile.app` copies `/home/appuser/.duckdb` with `--chown=appuser:appuser`, and `docker/Dockerfile.odl-hybrid` parses `ODL_HYBRID_EXTRA_ARGS` via `shlex.split` without shell word-splitting or glob expansion.

findings.summary: minio started without validating non-empty MINIO_ROOT_USER/MINIO_ROOT_PASSWORD (silently falling back to minioadmin:minioadmin when --profile minio was started with empty .env keys), and searxng defaulted SEARXNG_SECRET to a hardcoded public repository constant enabling forged /image_proxy HMAC signatures.

langfuse-db-init interpolated host ${DB_USER} and ${LANGFUSE_DB_NAME} directly into sh -c and psql SQL strings without identifier validation, and postgres healthcheck interpolated unquoted ${DB_USER}/${DB_NAME} into CMD-SHELL.

Dockerfile.app copied /root/.duckdb into /home/appuser/.duckdb without --chown=appuser:appuser, Dockerfile.odl-hybrid expanded ${ODL_HYBRID_EXTRA_ARGS} via unquoted bash -c word-splitting/globbing, and docker-compose omitted runtime env passthroughs (GENYEE_ALLOW_ROOT_DOCKER_SOCK_GID, GENYEE_CORS_ALLOWED_ORIGINS, DUCKDB_SKIP_EXTENSION_LOAD, GENYEE_LLM_*_TIMEOUT_SECONDS, GENYEE_WEB_FETCH_CHROMIUM_CONCURRENCY, ODL_HYBRID_MAX_FILE_SIZE_MB).

invariants_checked: `HybridSecurityASGIWrapper` enforces constant-time `hmac.compare_digest` bearer/`X-API-Key` authentication (requiring `ODL_HYBRID_AUTH_TOKEN` on non-loopback binds unless explicitly overridden), blocks `/v1/profile/file` with HTTP 404 by default, and enforces upload size limits on both `Content-Length` (rejecting negative/malformed values with HTTP 400 and oversize payloads with HTTP 413) and streamed ASGI body chunks.
CLI/env configuration (`ODL_HYBRID_PORT`, `ODL_HYBRID_MAX_FILE_SIZE_MB`) falls back cleanly when environment variables are unset or empty strings without startup `ValueError` crashes.

findings.summary: Setting ODL_HYBRID_PORT='' crashed main() with ValueError before argparse could parse CLI flags, and HybridSecurityASGIWrapper accepted negative Content-Length headers instead of rejecting them with HTTP 400.

invariants_checked: Browser secret fill (`gy-secret-fill.mjs`) verifies HTTPS + domain allowlist BEFORE clicking/focusing any element AND re-verifies frame identity prior to `Input.insertText`, checks true HTML `<input>` IDL `el.type === "password"` (blocking `<textarea type="password">` and whitespace-padded attribute spoofing), unlinks and zeroes the one-time AES-256-GCM key file immediately, and never logs secret values.

CDP discovery and connection (`cdp-cookies.mjs`, `gy-browser-sync.mjs`, `gy-ua-governor.mjs`, `gy-secret-fill.mjs`) validate `/json/version` `webSocketDebuggerUrl` against strict `ws://127.0.0.1:<port>/devtools/browser/<guid>` rules, enforce `AbortSignal.timeout` on all `/json/version` fetches, and verify `expectedBrowserId` to prevent port-reuse session cross-talk.

`agent-browser-wrapper.sh` strips caller `--session`/`--profile`/`--cdp`/`--provider`/`-p*`/`--config`/`--args`/`--extension`/`--init-script` overrides and consumes all value-taking global flags so `connect` and password-reading `eval` guards cannot be bypassed; `gy-cookie-plan.mjs` guards `Object.prototype` domain keys via `Object.hasOwn`; `gy-chrome.sh`, `gy-display.sh`, and `gy-ua-governor.sh` enforce `0700`/`0600` private state/log paths and strict session-ID validation.

findings.summary: ACTIVE_FIELD read raw el.getAttribute('type') before checking tagName === 'INPUT' and IDL el.type, allowing a page with <textarea type='password'> or whitespace-padded <input type=' password '> (IDL type 'text') to receive cleartext password fills, and fillFields invoked focus(field.ref) before checking originStatus on the current frame URL.
findings.regression_test: ACTIVE_FIELD rejects textarea[type=password] and padded input type spoofing, fillFields checks originStatus before focusing any ref and main forwards expectedBrowserId

findings.summary: getBrowserWsUrl accepted arbitrary webSocketDebuggerUrl hosts/ports/paths from /json/version without loopback/port/path validation, getBrowserVersion lacked an AbortSignal timeout on stalled endpoints, and connectBrowser did not verify expectedBrowserId against CDP port reuse.
findings.regression_test: getBrowserWsUrl rejects non-loopback or mismatched-port debugger URLs and connectBrowser enforces expectedBrowserId, getBrowserVersion aborts stalled /json/version endpoints

findings.summary: agent-browser-wrapper.sh did not consume value-taking global flags (--proxy, --download-path, --user-agent, --headers, etc.) before subcommand detection and missed attached short -p<provider> flags, allowing callers to shift SUBCMD past the connect and password-eval security guards.

planSync indexed plain objects with cookie domain names without Object.hasOwn guards (throwing TypeError on Object.prototype keys like 'constructor'/'toString'/'__proto__'), gy-chrome.sh appended session click logs to shared /tmp/gy-chrome.log instead of a 0600 file inside the session browser root, gy-display.sh valid_sid allowed '.'/'..'/leading-dot/leading-dash IDs, and gy-ua-governor.sh lacked chmod 0700 on LOCK_DIR and a run.sh test harness entry.
findings.regression_test: planSync handles Object.prototype domain keys without throwing, t_session_log_is_written_under_browser_root_not_world_readable_tmp, t_valid_sid_rejects_dot_and_hyphen_prefixed_ids, test_gy_ua_governor.sh

invariants_checked: All shell (`test_*.sh`) and Node (`test_*.mjs`) suites in `docker/scripts/tests/run.sh` syntax-check every script in `docker/scripts` and execute unit/integration tests covering wrapper flag stripping, CDP validation, cookie sync planning, seat display management, Chrome GUI shim, secret fill, and UA/timezone governance (`test_gy_ua_governor.sh`).
Test stubs (`agent-browser`, `chrome`, `fake-x-stack.sh`) remain isolated to temporary directories provided by the test harness with zero hardcoded host paths or network calls.

`MCPAuthMiddleware` in `examples/mcp-demo/server.py` enforces constant-time `secrets.compare_digest` bearer / `x-mcp-auth-token` authentication (`MIN_AUTH_TOKEN_LENGTH = 32`) on HTTP requests, passes only ASGI `lifespan` events unauthenticated, and closes unauthenticated `websocket` scopes with code `4401`.

`examples/mcp-demo/start.sh` and `test_tools.py` auto-generate and read a `0600` `.mcp-demo-token` (>= 32 chars, gitignored) when `MCP_SERVER_AUTH_TOKEN` is unset, never echo plaintext tokens to terminal stdout, and enable DNS-rebinding protection on loopback binds.

findings.summary: MCPAuthMiddleware forwarded non-http ASGI scopes (including unauthenticated websocket connections) directly to the inner app instead of restricting passthrough to lifespan, and start.sh/test_tools.py defaulted MCP_SERVER_AUTH_TOKEN to 17-char 'genyee-demo-token' (failing server.py's 32-char minimum out of the box) while echoing raw caller tokens to stdout.

invariants_checked: All 5 PDF utility scripts (`check_bounding_boxes.py`, `check_fillable_fields.py`, `convert_pdf_to_images.py`, `extract_form_field_info.py`, `fill_fillable_fields.py`) use `pypdf`/`pdf2image` with zero `pickle`, `yaml.load`, `eval`, shell invocations, or network requests, and compile cleanly under `py_compile`.

Helm templates quote scalar user-controlled values (`serviceAccountName`, `secretName`, `claimName`, `ingressClassName`, `tls.secretName`, PVC `storage`, `frontend.env` keys) against YAML boolean/numeric coercion and newline injection, while `_helpers.tpl` `genyee.formatImage` rejects whitespace/quotes via `fail` and preserves unquoted `image:` lines required by `.github/workflows/helm.yml`.

`secrets.yaml` enforces exact 32-byte length when `secrets.systemAesKey` is explicitly provided (matching Go `ValidateProductionAESKey`), `postgres.yaml` probes use secret-backed `PGUSER`/`PGDATABASE` instead of hardcoded `-U postgres`, and `networkpolicy.yaml` permits `component=app` peer-to-peer ingress on TCP 8080 for multi-replica BrowserSkill cluster forwarding.

findings.file: helm/templates/_helpers.tpl:123-145; helm/templates/serviceaccount.yaml:12; helm/templates/secrets.yaml:42; helm/templates/ingress.yaml:26,33; helm/templates/pvc.yaml:22,41,60,79; helm/templates/frontend.yaml:31,52; helm/templates/app.yaml:46,81-184,217; helm/templates/docreader.yaml:37,64; helm/templates/postgres.yaml:30,51-61,94; helm/templates/redis.yaml:30,55,60,97; helm/templates/neo4j.yaml:31,56,98
findings.summary: Unquoted user-controlled scalar values (serviceAccountName, secretName, claimName, ingressClassName, tls.secretName, PVC storage sizes, frontend.env keys) allowed YAML boolean/number coercion or newline key injection, and genyee.formatImage did not reject whitespace or quote characters in image registry/repository/tag inputs.

secrets.yaml accepted explicit secrets.systemAesKey values whose byte length was not 32 (causing app release-mode startup crash), postgres.yaml hardcoded '-U postgres' in liveness/readiness probes (failing when secrets.dbUser != 'postgres'), and networkpolicy.yaml blocked component=app peer pod traffic on TCP 8080 needed by multi-replica BrowserSkill cluster forwarding.

invariants_checked: All 27 unittest cases across `test_app_storage.py`, `test_delivery.py`, `test_docreader_tls_and_port.py`, and `test_security_hardening.py` pass alongside `helm lint ./helm`.

Preserved all protected license/attribution/historical files and kept `README.md`, `README_CN.md`, `README_JA.md`, and `README_KO.md` 100% byte-identical; audited `go.mod`, `go.sum`, `Makefile`, `Formula/genyee-lite.rb`, `.env.example`, `.env.lite.example`, `rerank_server_demo.py`, `.dockerignore`, `.gitignore`, `.gitattributes`, `.golangci.yml`, `VERSION`, `docreader/pyproject.toml`, and `mcp-server/pyproject.toml`.

`rerank_server_demo.py` safely falls back on empty integer env vars, binds to `127.0.0.1` with fail-closed `hmac.compare_digest` API key auth, requires a 40-char lowercase hex commit SHA on `RERANK_MODEL_REVISION` when `RERANK_TRUST_REMOTE_CODE=true` for remote repos, and forces `local_files_only=True` on unpinned local directories.

`Makefile` quotes `eval "$$(./scripts/get_version.sh env)"` and migration/docker build arguments; `Formula/genyee-lite.rb` validates `.env.lite` variable names against `[A-Za-z_][A-Za-z0-9_]*` before `export`.

findings.summary: rerank_server_demo.py crashed on empty integer env vars and accepted non-SHA branch/tag names (e.g. 'main') or unpinned local hub refs when RERANK_TRUST_REMOTE_CODE=true; Makefile ran unquoted eval on get_version.sh env and unquoted migration arguments; Formula/genyee-lite.rb exported .env.lite keys without shell identifier validation.

invariants_checked: Preserved all negative checks in `scripts/verify-commercial-compliance.sh` (`34/34` passing); verified license bundling (`check-license-bundle.sh`, `copy-licenses.sh`, `generate_npm_notices.mjs`), entrypoint GID checks (`docker-entrypoint.sh`), and air-gapped packaging (`offline-bundle.sh`, `offline-load.sh`, `export-source.sh`).

`scripts/build_images.sh` keeps Go module checksum verification enabled by default (`GOSUMDB_ARG=${GOSUMDB:-sum.golang.org}`), resolves `$PROJECT_ROOT/VERSION`, and quotes all `--platform` / `--build-arg` flags; `scripts/get_version.sh` resolves `PROJECT_ROOT` from `BASH_SOURCE[0]`, sanitizes version tokens, emits `printf '%s=%q\n'` in `env` mode, and JSON-escapes fields.

`scripts/start_all.sh`, `scripts/dev.sh`, and `scripts/test-homebrew.sh` populate empty mandatory secrets on both newly created and pre-copied CRLF/LF `.env` files under `umask 077` (`0600` mode); `scripts/migrate.sh` preserves explicit caller env vars over `.env`, URL-encodes `DB_USER`/`DB_PASSWORD`/`DB_NAME`, redacts query-string `password=` in logs, and validates `force` integer versions; `scripts/offline-load.sh` rejects symlinks in bundles; `scripts/offline-bundle.sh` generates `SEARXNG_SECRET` when `searxng` profile is enabled; `scripts/export-source.sh` blocks leading-`-` `git archive` option injection and supports relative output paths from any CWD.

findings.summary: build_images.sh disabled Go module checksum verification by default (GOSUMDB_ARG=${GOSUMDB:-off}), read CWD-relative VERSION, and left --platform/--build-arg expansions unquoted; get_version.sh emitted unescaped EDITION/VERSION/COMMIT_ID values consumed via shell eval and JSON templates.

start_all.sh skipped secret generation on pre-copied .env files with empty keys and sourced CRLF .env files raw; dev.sh ensure_dev_secrets did not enforce 0600 permissions; migrate.sh let .env clobber explicit caller DB_* env vars, left DB_USER/DB_NAME unencoded in postgres:// URLs, leaked query-string ?password= in REDACTED_DB_URL, and lacked integer validation on force.

offline-load.sh scanned regular files (-type f) without rejecting symlinks inside the bundle directory, offline-bundle.sh omitted SEARXNG_SECRET generation when the searxng profile was enabled, and export-source.sh passed unvalidated GIT_REF to git archive (allowing leading '-' option injection) and resolved relative OUTPUT_TAR against PROJECT_ROOT instead of caller CWD.

verification_commands: bash scripts/docker-entrypoint_test.sh && bash scripts/check-license-bundle.sh && bash scripts/test-license-bundle.sh (exit 0)

findings.summary: prepare.sh extracted tarballs as root without --no-same-owner/--no-same-permissions, omitted bind-mounted docker/searxng/settings.yml and misc/dex-config.yaml, and left /opt/GENYEE hardcoded in installed systemd units when GENYEE_DIR was customized; cleanup.sh wrote secret-scan paths to predictable /tmp/cleanup-secrets-found.txt.

`scripts/wemm-transformers/serve.py` binds to loopback by default, enforces fail-closed `hmac.compare_digest` bearer auth, caps request body size to 32 MiB and decoded images to 40 MP, blocks remote URL / `file:` image SSRF by accepting only `data:image/*;base64,...`, and requires a 40-char lowercase hex commit SHA before honoring `WEMM_TRUST_REMOTE_CODE=true`.
